name: Shabbethai
overview: The Scriptures identify Shabbethai as a dedicated Levite who played significant roles in the service of God's house. He assisted Ezra in important matters, exemplifying faithful support in the restoration efforts. Shabbethai also served as an expounder of the law, helping the people understand God's commands, and held a leadership position overseeing the outward business of the temple, demonstrating trusted responsibility in temple administration.
